maya: Heads-up — after the latest post-quant bring-up of hummus-7B-q4 we started seeing tool/function-call JSON payloads being split across tokens, causing our JSON-mode parser to choke. Repro steps in a sec.

samir: ack, can you paste a minimal example?

maya: yes. send to model: 
```json
{"tool":"lookup_price","args":{"sku":"12345","currency":"USD"}}
```
The RW bridge sees token sequence where the opening <JSON> sentinel and the first `{` end up separated by quantized expansion: tokens: [50256, 13, 123, 9, 7, 123] — note the role and tool tags are getting split.

alex: is this the tokenizer mismatch (hf vs rw special tokens) or something in fastpath quantize bpe merge?

maya: initial hunch: tokenizer config.json in the HF artifact had `add_prefix_space: true` and a custom `bos_token` that collides with our <json_mode> sentinel. Post-quant we changed merges and a couple of multi-byte special tokens got remapped into two subword tokens.

jen: can you dump the tokenizer.special_tokens_map and the config.json mapping? might be a simple remap fix on conversion.

maya: pasted snippets: 
```
"special_tokens_map": {"<json_mode>": "<|json|>", "<tool>": "<|tool|>", "<role_human>": "<|user|>"}
"config": {"add_prefix_space": true, "bos_token": "<|start|>", "eos_token": "<|end|>"}
```
But after quantize pass, tokenizer returns token ids [1012, 4] for `<|json|>` instead of single id 40990. That split breaks our toolcall parser which expects the sentinel as single-token anchor.

samir: ok that explains behavior. Two follow-ups: 1) can we reserve those special tokens at conversion time (force-add) so they have stable ids pre- and post-quant, 2) add a fallback in RW bridge to detect sentinel sequences of byte-aligned tokens and rejoin?

alex: for (1) conversion script can call tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": ["<|json|>","<|tool|>"]}) before saving. For (2) we already have prefix rejoin heuristics but they only run for whitespace splits, not multi-token splits. We should extend them to handle known special token subsequences.

maya: I tried adding add_special_tokens but the HF -> RW conversion path (hf_to_rw.py) sometimes normalizes tokens via `tokenizer._build_special_tokens_map` which then uses merges; need to ensure we assign explicit ids with `tokenizer.add_tokens([...], special_tokens=True)` and then `tokenizer.save_pretrained` so quantize doesn't reassign.

jen: note: this will affect embeddings size and tokenizer.vocab_size — we need migration plan for existing customers who pinned model versions. Maybe flag as an onboarding step: "ensure special tokens pinned" in the bring-up checklist.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-06-15T18:10:00Z — hummus-7B-q4 deployed to staging (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

samir: for short-term patch I'll add bridge-level tolerant parsing: if we see `<` `|` `json` `|` `>` split across tokens, recompose string and treat as sentinel. But we should also add unit tests that quantize then decode and assert special tokens map roundtrips.

maya: thanks. I'll file a small PR for hf_to_rw conversion to call add_tokens(special) and update onboarding doc with a step to verify special token ids after quant.

alex: also add a lint in model onboarding: run `python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); assert t.token_to_id('<|json|>') is not None\"` and fail onboarding if missing.

jen: +1. Can we also add a quick eval that runs a handful of toolcall prompts through quantized model and checks JSON parse success rate > 99%? catches regressions.

samir: agreed. I'll take the bridge patch, maya make the conversion change, alex/jen add onboarding checks and eval.

maya: assigning tasks in thread. thanks everyone — will follow up with PR links. :thumbsup:
